en.answer: When Tribute Summoning an "Earthbound Immortal" monster and applying the effect of <<14594>> that treats Synchro Monsters as 2 Tributes, you can Tribute a face-down Defense Position Synchro Monster.
en.question: When Tribute Summoning an "Earthbound Immortal" monster and applying the effect of <<14594>> that treats Synchro Monsters as 2 Tributes, can I Tribute a face-down Defense Position Synchro Monster in my Monster Zone?
